Due to legal restrictions on the handling and storage of these high-power lithium batteries, any returns require the red transportation cap to be accepted in any of our stores.

DEWALT DCB546-XJ 54V 6.0Ah Li-Ion XR FlexVolt battery provides cordless power for demanding trade applications. The high-capacity battery delivers power comparable to a corded tool, ensuring consistent performance for heavy-duty tasks on site or in the workshop. Offers extended run times on traditional XR power tools, reducing interruptions during long working days. A state of charge indicator allows for quick battery level checks, helping professionals manage their workflow efficiently. Compatible with all XR FlexVolt and XR 18V tools. 40 minute charge time with the XR FlexVolt charger DCB118 (available separately).
b: Extended Run Times on XR Power Tools
Fast 40-Minute Charge Time with DCB118 Charger
Broad Compatibility Across XR & FlexVolt Tool Ranges
